_comment: The repo's About box — description, website and topics. GitHub stores these as repo settings, not as files, so this is the source of truth for what they should be. Apply with: node .github/apply-about.mjs --apply (needs `gh` authenticated). Topics are capped at 20 by GitHub; the list is full, so adding one means arguing another out.
description: Bộ kit để IDE agentic (Claude Code, Antigravity) tự dựng agent nội dung: crawl → viết → cổng duyệt → đăng social. Kèm pipeline video 9:16 với 127 template và 3 backend (HTML/Chrome · Veo · Remotion), kho skill SEO-marketing cài theo yêu cầu, và MCP cho quảng cáo + Canva. Zero dependency, env-only, MIT.
_actions: What the Actions GITHUB_TOKEN is allowed to do. `can_create_pull_requests` MUST be true or .github/workflows/registry-watch.yml cannot open its pull request — the API refuses regardless of the `permissions: pull-requests: write` block in the workflow file, because this repo-level switch is checked first and it defaults to false. `default_permissions` stays `read` on purpose: a workflow needing more asks in its own `permissions:` block, where the request is visible in the diff instead of granted to everything at once.
_features: Repo features. Wiki is OFF: an empty wiki tab is a dead end for anyone who clicks it, and everything it could hold already lives in docs/ where it is versioned, reviewed and searchable in the same place as the code. Issues and Discussions stay on — those are where people talk to you.
